scope: Read primary papers, author implementations, patent text and official manufacturer/NIST documents; no secondary technical claims relied on.

source_policy.quote_provenance: No verbatim body quotation is used. Document titles identify sources; all body claims are paraphrases or explicitly original derivations.

source_policy.unidentified_thesis: Leoben-area CC1101/Si5341 thesis remains unverified and is deliberately omitted under operator authorization.
